Of course! Here’s how I would speak to him as a yoga coach:  

---

Hi there! You're doing a great job stepping into Warrior One—it’s a strong and empowering pose. Let’s take a moment to refine it so you can feel even more balanced and aligned.  

First, I noticed that your spine isn’t quite straight right now. Take a deep breath and imagine lengthening your back as you root down through your feet. Think about lifting up through your chest while gently tucking your tailbone down. This will help you find that balance between grounding and elongating your spine.  

Next, let’s take a look at your arms. They’re reaching up, but not fully straight just yet. I want you to focus on extending your arms directly upwards, palms facing each other, and fingers energized, as though you’re trying to touch the sky. Keep your shoulders relaxed and down as your arms stretch tall—this will help you feel more spacious and open.  

Finally, let’s check in with your front knee. It’s not quite sitting directly over your ankle right now. Try shifting your pressure forward slightly and aligning your knee directly on top of the ankle to create stability. Be mindful not to lean in too far—it should feel strong but not forced.  

Take your time with these adjustments, and don’t rush. This pose is all about finding strength and ease in balance. You’re doing really well, and it takes practice to nail all of these details—you’ve got this!  

Let me know how that feels, and I’ll be right here to guide you further. Great effort so far!

---  

Encouragement and precision go hand-in-hand—he’ll appreciate the constructive feedback with sensitivity. :)
